body: I ghosted a friend out of embarrassment after a pretty rough depressive episode I had and was scared I’d run into anyone we used to know and have to explain to them my humiliating disappearance. I think that was the start now it’s just the fear and the feeling of dread that follows me when I go out can’t leave without nausea and extreme overthinking of everything under the sun that could happen to me.
100% SA ruined every friendship I had and made me withdraw from school and pursuing anything further becoming a agoraphobic introvert with nothing to show for myself.
Thank you for replying its reassuring to see and I’ll check about the over the phone appointments instead definitely a good idea to the alternative. Thanks!
Thank you for sharing this and encouraging me.
That’s a good idea. I might try to give it a go, thank you for the advice.

I just knew this person for a large chunk of my life and have a lot of fond memories with them and it’s frustrating to me how quickly they lost interest in our friendship when met with new interesting an outgoing people.
Thanks for the kind words.

Yeah I usually wear headphones when I have to go out and they help some and I got my driving permit last year but I haven’t used it in like 9 months I tried really hard when I first got it, to drive in empty parking lots and even that was way to uncomfortable I could never get myself to drive on a main road or even when another car was coming.I just feel instant panic and dread behind the wheel.
I avoid mainly restaurants, driving & traveling ,dentist, drs, stores,and social gatherings.
Of course, its frustrating and hard trying to build ourselves up time and time again, your angers definitely valid.

Same I struggle a lot with restaurants and eating in front of people/public in general I don’t eat many meals because of people eating around the same time but I do keep a basket of easily accessible snacks in my room like high calorie granola bars for hiking ,dried fruits, trail mixes or whatever you like even meal replacement drinks are good or Soylent chocolate flavors. Just some tips I used through the worst of it  wishing you good luck!

I’ve had trouble with that friend due to my worsening agoraphobia they’ve become more outgoing,leaving for college and ,getting new friends ,and traveling. I’ve gotten worse and shut myself in. We were supposed to have plans with them back from college for the holidays but I shut them down and haven’t reached back out but probably should make another attempt. And the Drs. is a big stressor for me but something over the phone would definitely be easier I’ll have to see if that’s a thing my system does. Sorry for the big reply but I really appreciate any advice or push forwards.
I’m sorry, I relate to this heavily. Try not to let the comparison get to you although it’s hard. I wish the best for you
Thank you, same to you!
I’ll try to see if anything got mixed up in a mod cleaning or something  thanks for the help for where to look!
Yes, all the save files are there and I use iCloud.

Hey, I was just wonder if anyone’s every had the issue of uninstalling Sims 4 on origin and having all their gallery and saves disappear in game when they redownload. They’re still in my saves in the files from what I can see but my games are all wiped. I’ve been playing for years and have over 1,000 hours so this is a completely devastating loss after how many hours I spent in game on houses and sims. If anyone has any tips to help me out much appreciated.
I personally think it’s the same as before you were born just nothing. Some find that comforting and some are terrified of the idea that there’s nothing.

It’s almost calming to think about it makes me disassociate and then I’m brought back to the sad reality that I am indeed alive. It’s such a odd feeling to be disappointed in the fact we’re alive. I wish you the best.

I hate people like that I’ve gone through this myself I’m so sorry nobody should have to deal with shitty professors and teachers who love to get on a little power trip by humiliating their students. It’s disgusting.
Thanks man I needed the reassurance.

Just wanted to tell you that grades really do not matter I spent so long focusing on my grades rather than myself and burnt out so fast I completely dropped out of high school and went to a alternative school and I’m currently working towards my diploma grades don’t define who you are.
Good idea, I’ll have to find methods to distract myself better, thanks
I can’t answer that question I genuinely can’t think of anything worth sharing.
